description:
Roll Persuade vs Riddle against a humanoid creature within short range. If you or your allies are engaged in combat with it, the creature's roll is favored.

On a win, the creature is charmed by you for the next hour or until you or your allies harm it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. If you or your allies do anything harmful to the creature, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.

Describe how you charm them.
name: Charm Person
successes:
✨: On a win, the effect lasts for 1 additional hour.

🌞: On a win, the effect instead lasts for 1 day.

improvements.name: Dominate Person
improvements.description:
On a win:

  • While the effect lasts, you have a telepathic link with the creature. You may use this link to issue simple commands to the creature as a free action, which it does its best to obey.

  • You may spend an action to take total and precise control of the target. For the next round, the creature spends its movement, actions and reactions as you choose, and doesn’t do anything that you don’t allow it to do. While you maintain this control, each time the creature takes damage, you must roll Persuade vs Riddle. On a loss, the spell ends.

On a loss, the creature checks a Condition.
